reports.title: Duke Energy reports third-quarter 2026 financial results

lines: ▪Company narrows 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $6.70 to $6.80; strong year-to-date performance positions company to deliver results near the top end

The company is narrowing its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $6.70 to $6.80 and reaffirming its long-term adjusted EPS growth rate of 5% to 7% through 2030 off the 2025 guidance range midpoint of $6.30, with confidence to earn in the top half of the range beginning in 2028.
